title: finding(pm-dispatch): `contract-review.md`'s 降档保险丝 and `dispatch-gates.mjs`'s clause-② docblock give OPPOSITE answers for a non-spec lane below tier — and the wrong reading has stood objectui#8167 down three times
body:
Dedup keywords: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` · 降档保险丝 · clause-② review tier · non-spec lane self-review · `contract-review.md` 复核归属

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat at objectui, `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`, after acting on the stricter of the two texts per SKILL.md 〈优先级〉 (「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」). ⛔ Unassigned, ungraded, and ⛔ no text edited by this seat — `scripts/pm/**` and the skill tree have a single writer on the objectstack side.

## The two texts, and where they disagree

Both describe who renders the clause-② contract review when the seat is **below** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

| source | what it says |
|:--|:--|
| `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, clause-② docblock (at `0b31d90`) | a clause-② card is built at the default tier and *"REVIEWED at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` — **in the spec seat only**, since the 2026-09-10 ruling; **every other lane's clause-② review is that lane's own default-tier review plus the gates**, and neither the triage seat nor the maintainer-summoned director spawns a contract-review-tier subagent for anything"* |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`, 复核归属与资格 | 「按档位:达档席内审契约增量;**未达档 ⛔ 不自审,走保险丝路**;豁免仅独立性件与保险丝」 |
| same file, 降档保险丝 | 「**保险丝管每个出条款②裁决的席**:每场前必读服役档(`platform-readings.md`),未达档 ⛔ 不自审」 · 「读数不达档 ⇒ 改走转录核验的达档复核子代理」 |

⇒ for a **non-spec lane sitting below tier** — the ordinary case for `domain:ui`, `domain:cli`, `domain:engine`, `domain:services` — the first text says *self-review at your own default tier* and the second says *⛔ never self-review, route to an isolated at-tier subagent*. They cannot both be followed.

## Why this is not academic — it has been costing a card

objectui#8167 (the lane's oldest p2 Bug, director-ruled complete on 2026-09-17T15:25Z) was stood down for **"the tier bar"** three times: 2026-09-16T16:10Z, 2026-09-17T00:48Z, and 2026-09-18T02:07Z (objectui comment `5724009276`), the last concluding it *"is not dispatchable as an ordinary card today"*.

⭐ **That conclusion does not follow from either text**, and the distinction is the point worth encoding: the disputed half is the **REVIEW** tier, never the **BUILD** tier. Both texts agree a clause-② card is *built* at the default judgment tier. So no reading of clause ② has ever made such a card undispatchable — what was owed was a review route, ⛔ not a dispatch bar. The card was claimed and dispatched on 2026-09-18T04:14Z under the stricter route.

⚠️ Note the seat-post half of the same drift: objectui#5560 §0a records 「the tier fuse binds only the spec seat and the skills seat — ⛔ not this lane」, sourced to a `7aae005` reading. `contract-review.md`'s current text says 每个出条款②裁决的席. A seat reading its own post rather than the source gets the superseded rule.

## The ask

Settle which text governs for a non-spec lane below tier, and make the loser point at the winner. ⛔ This card does not propose the answer — both directions are defensible and the choice has a real cost either way:

- **dispatch-gates' reading** (lane self-reviews at default tier) is cheaper and is what the 2026-09-10 ruling is quoted as saying, but it means a clause-② verdict of record can be rendered below `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, which is exactly what the fuse exists to refuse;
- **contract-review.md's reading** (isolated at-tier subagent, transcript-verified) is stricter and self-consistent with the `Served-tier:` requirement and with `--pair` exiting 4 when that line is not the constant name — but it contradicts the docblock's explicit *"neither the triage seat nor the maintainer-summoned director spawns a contract-review-tier subagent for anything"*.

⚠️ One mechanical detail that may decide it on its own: the 同形 record requires a first line `Served-tier:` whose value is the constant name `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, and `check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair` exits 4 when it is not. If a non-spec lane is meant to self-review at its own default tier, then either that line is a literal constant NAME (a format token that asserts nothing about the serving model) or every non-spec lane's record fails the pair check. Which of those two it is was ⛔ not measured by this seat.
